text:
arjun: heads up — eu-west-1 GPU onboarding is stuck, several nodes never finish boot. noticed after the firewall tighten this morning :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT: node-provisioning-failure (eu-west-1) 1719554319 — 18 nodes failing join
maria: repro? any obvious errors in node logs?
arjun: kubelet logs show KMS decrypt failures during bootstrap. example:
```
  03:12:14 kubelet bootstrap: failed to decrypt keystore with KMS: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
  03:12:14 runtime: node bootstrap failed, marking for retry
```
lee: is the keystore behind privatelink? if the firewall change blocked egress to the privatelink endpoint that would explain it.
sara: saw autoscaler behaviour — it scaled up then marked nodes NotReady and scaled back, so we have warm-pool churn and a transient capacity hole. customers hitting higher token latencies.
jonathan: cost note — repeated reboots + new allocations bumped short-term spend on on-demand GPUs by ~+22% in the last 30m. we should limit churn.
maria: can we temporarily exempt the keystore endpoint from the new FW policy? need a quick rule to allow keystore-eu endpoint IPs/privatelink endpoint id.
security-bot: Policy change id pc-2026-03-21-07 applied 1719551200. Approval chain: ops -> infra -> security. Reverting requires infra approval.
arjun: quick mitigation plan: 1) add SG allow for keystore privatelink cidr on control-plane subnets 2) pause policy enforcement for region eu-west-1 3) throttle autoscaler to avoid oscillation
lee: sg update command: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.200.0.0/22` — will open to keystore subnet.
sara: if we open SG, we should also add a short-lived allowlist tag so audit tracks it. i'll prepare a runbook entry.
jonathan: also consider mounting a local keystore cache on bootstrap image so future node restarts won't require KMS during early boot. longer term.
maria: giving infra the thumbs — @lee can you push the SG change and monitor join rate? :thumbsup: 
lee: pushed rule, patch id sg-patch-1719554380. running `kubectl get nodes --selector=pool=gpu -o wide` now.
ops-bot: 1719554405: infra job sg-patch-1719554380 applied by lee — validation in progress
arjun: seeing nodes join: 6 -> 14 in the last 2 minutes. still some backpressure but much better.
sara: autoscaler hold set to 10m to reduce churn.
security-bot: Note: temporary allow will be auto-rolled in 30m unless security approves extension. Please file follow-up ticket with audit notes.
maria: filing ticket INFRA-3124 with timeline and cost hit, tagging security and platform.
jonathan: tracking cost impact in the ticket, will propose a hotfix: pre-warmed cached-keys and failing fast fallback to hosted keystore replica in another AZ.
arjun: thanks all. follow-up actions: security to review why policy blocked privatelink endpoints, infra to add keystore traffic exemption pattern to rollout checklist, eng-sre to watch warm pool metrics for 2h.
lee: will keep an eye, will post metrics in 10m. :rocket:
ops-bot: RESOLVED? provisional mitigations in place. monitoring for 30m window.
